title: Traditional bezel
stone: Faceted stones, round or oval. A medium to large stone is ideal for this setting, because the ring is welded to the bezel. Be careful with a deep stone: it needs a much taller bezel, and that can look out of proportion.
about: A traditional bezel holds a center diamond or gemstone in a custom-fitted rim of precious metal. The rim secures the stone without prongs, and it may encircle the stone completely or only in part. This setting is a full bezel: a continuous band of metal surrounds the whole perimeter, for edge protection and snag-free everyday wear. The stone is faceted, in a round or oval shape.
Bezel settings date back to ancient Egyptian, Greek, and Roman metalwork. They became widely popular in the Art Deco era of the 1920s and 1930s for their clean, geometric lines.

points.name: High security.
points.text: The metal collar firmly locks the stone in, so there is less risk of losing a gem than with prongs.

points.name: Snag-free profile.
points.text: A smooth, low profile keeps the ring from catching on clothing, hair, or everyday objects.

points.name: Visual impact.
points.text: The metal frame can make the center stone look slightly larger, or more sharply defined.

points.name: Solid, and repairable for decades.
points.text: A solid handmade piece can be sized, re-soldered, or restored years later. Hollow or plated factory pieces often melt or crack under a jeweler's torch.

priceNote: Included is part of the sterling price: no skirt, high polish, and antique. The price shown is the price at the time of the order. It follows the metal price.

choices.name: Antique
choices.detail: Dark in the grooves of the skirt, so the skirt has contrast. Left unplated.

options.name: Rhodium plate
options.rule: Rhodium plate can be added to high polish. Antique is left unplated.

fingerSize: Finger size is required with every order. Ask for it when the setting is written down.
leadTime: The setting is made to order once the stone is chosen. Allow 2 weeks. These are made one at a time, part time, so I take a limited number of orders at once.
weightNote: Solid metal all the way through, with a reassuring weight on the finger. Nothing here is hollowed out or lightened to save material.
